1. From San Francisco to Tokyo on May 3, 2022.
2. From Tokyo to Sydney on May 18, 2022.

We need to call the function twice. The function signature expects departure_city, destination_city, date. The date format is string. The user gave dates as "2022年5月3日" and "2022年5月18日". We should convert them to a standard date string. The function likely expects something like "2022-05-03" or "2022/05/03". But we don't know exactly. The user used Chinese characters for year, month, day. We can interpret that as "2022-05-03" and "2022-05-18". We'll use ISO format "YYYY-MM-DD".

We also need to provide departure_city and destination_city. The user wrote "舊金山" (San Francisco) and "東京" (Tokyo). For the second flight, departure_city is "東京" and destination_city is "雪梨" (Sydney). So we need to call the function twice.

We need to produce the function calls. The user didn't ask for anything else. So we just call the function twice.
